name: animafest
description: A modern, high-performance internship platform clone developed with a "Pure JSON" backend and a premium "Glassmorphism" frontend.

scripts.dev: lsof -ti:3000,3001 | xargs kill -9 || true && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
